changelog: `SaralGatiAccessibilityService` drops from 1341 to 936 lines: the five helpers that only ever read the node they are handed - element role, human-readable label, Activity-vs-widget classification, endless-feed detection and scrollable discovery - moved into `UiElementLabels.kt` and `ScreenTraversal.kt` in the same package, so no call site changed and the service keeps only the part that needs its own state. Every moved block was diffed byte-for-byte against the original. Previous release: every API route became a thin adapter over a new `src/server` service layer.
